resolution_note: Aliases are convenience metadata only. Natural-language continuation is resolved semantically by intent/domain/task context, then mechanically by exact/default-resume rules. A bare generic inheritance request with no resolved target opens the current selector instead of silently selecting a task. Registered domain routers do not own child business identities; exact child references are resolved by the owning domain. Controller maintenance uses the same index under controller_tasks and exact state under state/tasks; it does not create a second continuity system.
